text: A. GENERAL 1. This form is to be used to report all National Workshops. The time and mission for the Instructor, Aides, and Instructor Trainees, are recorded, as well as those of the attendees. No ANSC 7030 — Activity Report is needed. WORKSHOP SPONSORS should remind Instructors and Attendees to report any preparation or travel time as 99D in AUXDATA Il or on their ANSC 7029 Member Activity Log. Time spent at the session will be accounted for with this form.
